t: 凯瑟琳·霍华德(Catherine Howard)是英格兰亨利八世的第五任妻子,因通奸被处死.
te: Catherine Howard, the fifth wife of Henry VIII of England, is executed for adultery.
dz: 凯瑟琳·霍华德(Catherine Howard)是英格兰亨利八世的第五任妻子,因通奸被处死.
de: Catherine Howard, the fifth wife of Henry VIII of England, is executed for adultery.

dz: Francis Xavier到达了当时葡萄牙印度的首都Old Goa.

dz: 普罗梅王国在今缅甸倒下为通古道.

dz: 在离开太平洋海岸的瓜亚基尔后一年半,弗朗西斯科·德·奥雷利亚纳完成了穿越南美洲的陆路旅程并到达大西洋海岸的亚马逊河口.
de: A year and a half after leaving Guayaquil on the Pacific coast, Francisco de Orellana finishes his overland journey across South America and reaches the mouth of the Amazon River on the Atlantic coast.

te: Battle of Wofla: The Portuguese are scattered, their leader Christovão da Gama is captured and later executed.
dz: 土耳其-葡萄牙战争:沃夫拉战役:葡萄牙人被放逐,他们的领袖克里斯托万·达·加马被俘后被处决.
de: Turkish–Portuguese War: Battle of Wofla: The Portuguese are scattered, their leader Christovão da Gama is captured and later executed.

dz: 葡萄牙的Juan Rodríguez Cabrillo来到了现在的加利福尼亚州圣地亚哥。 他是加州第一个欧洲人.
de: Juan Rodríguez Cabrillo of Portugal arrives at what is now San Diego, California. He is the first European in California.

t: 一支英格兰军队在达姆弗里斯和加洛韦的埃斯克河附近击败了一支更大规模的苏格兰部队.
te: An English army defeats a much larger Scottish force near the River Esk in Dumfries and Galloway.
dz: 索尔韦·莫斯战役:一支英格兰军队在达姆弗里斯和加洛韦的埃斯克河附近击败了一支更大规模的苏格兰部队.
de: Battle of Solway Moss: An English army defeats a much larger Scottish force near the River Esk in Dumfries and Galloway.

t: 一群明朝宫女刺杀嘉靖皇帝失败，被慢斩处决。
te: A group of Ming dynasty palace women fail to murder the Jiajing Emperor, and are executed by slow-slicing.
dz: 壬寅年宫剧情：一群明朝宫女刺杀嘉靖皇帝失败，被慢斩处决。
de: Palace plot of Renyin year: A group of Ming dynasty palace women fail to murder the Jiajing Emperor, and are executed by slow-slicing.

te: Princess Mary Stuart becomes Queen of Scots at the age of one week on the death of her father, King James V.
dz: 玛丽·斯图亚特公主在父亲詹姆斯五世国王去世后一周就成为苏格兰女王.
